overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons chicken menu?
overview.body:
The section brings together roasted chicken, coated chicken baskets, wings, curry and a plant-based nugget basket. Lemon and herb half chicken offers a lemon-and-herb marinade, while spicy peri-peri half chicken takes the same broad format in a hotter direction. Chicken jalfrezi is the curry choice, described with aromatic spices, green chillies and mixed peppers. These are different styles of meal, rather than variations on a single chicken dish.

For coated chicken, compare the southern-fried chicken strips basket with the chicken breast bites basket. The strips have a seasoned, slightly spiced breadcrumb coating; the bites use batter. Both descriptions include chips and a choice of dipping sauce. Spicy chicken wings offer a tangy, lingering heat, while the Quorn no chicken nuggets basket is the section's labelled vegetarian and vegan alternative.

overview.heading: Chicken baskets, half chickens or wings?
overview.body:
The main portion formats are half chickens, baskets of smaller pieces and a serving of ten wings. A half chicken gives you a different eating experience from strips or bites, so choose the format you actually want rather than judging by the dish name alone. Lemon and herb half chicken is described with coleslaw, but its supplied description does not identify every accompaniment. The peri-peri description also leaves its [sides](/sides) unspecified.

The southern-fried basket contains five chicken breast strips with chips and a dipping sauce. Chicken breast bites also come with chips and a sauce, although no piece count is supplied. The Quorn basket contains eight nuggets, with no complete side description available here. Wings are described as suitable for sharing or as a meal for one. Those counts help explain the formats, but they do not establish equal portion weights or comparable fullness.

overview.heading: Which chicken dishes include a drink?
overview.body:
No individual dish in this section is confirmed here as including a drink. That distinction matters when comparing prices: a food price and a food-plus-drink offer are not necessarily equivalent. Chicken jalfrezi is the relevant dish to investigate if you are looking at [Curry Club](/curry-club), which traditionally takes place on Thursday at participating pubs and often includes a drink. Its presence in this category does not, by itself, confirm eligibility for that offer.

Check the local offer wording before treating any basket, half chicken or curry as a meal deal. Ask which drinks qualify, whether your chosen dish is included and what total applies at that pub. A southern-fried chicken strips basket already has chips and a dipping sauce in its description, but those accompaniments should not be confused with an included drink.

overview.heading: Do Wetherspoons chicken dishes change seasonally?

No seasonal chicken special or rotating dish is identified in the supplied menu information. The listed selection consists of chicken jalfrezi, the strips and bites baskets, lemon and herb and peri-peri half chickens, spicy wings and the Quorn nugget basket. Use those dishes as the starting point for your decision, not as evidence that additional seasonal versions will appear.

Before making a trip for a particular dish, check the menu at your chosen pub. Ask whether the item is being served and whether its accompaniments match the description you have seen. This is especially useful for the half chickens and Quorn basket, whose supplied descriptions do not fully specify their sides. If a local menu shows an additional chicken dish, compare its stated ingredients, portion format and typical local price rather than assuming it resembles an existing option.
